Accounts Detail Implementation Plan ​

For agentic workers: REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (- [ ]) syntax for tracking.

Goal: Add an Account Detail page with three tabs (Transactions, Holdings, Performance) and extend the list page with staleness indicators and one-click export links.

Architecture: Add a /api/accounts/{id}/transactions endpoint (with filtering) and a /api/accounts/{id}/performance endpoint to the existing accounts router. The frontend adds an AccountDetail page component with three tabs driven by URL query params; the existing Accounts list page gets staleness color coding and export link buttons.

Tech Stack: Python/FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, React 18, TypeScript, Recharts

@router.get("/{account_id}/transactions")
def get_account_transactions(
    account_id: int,
    type: Optional[str] = None,
    symbol: Optional[str] = None,
    start_date: Optional[str] = None,
    end_date: Optional[str] = None,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    account = db.query(Account).get(account_id)
    if not account:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Account not found")
    q = db.query(Transaction).filter(Transaction.account_id == account_id)
    if type:
        q = q.filter(Transaction.type == type)
    if symbol:
        q = q.filter(Transaction.symbol.ilike(f"%{symbol}%"))
    if start_date:
        q = q.filter(Transaction.date >= start_date)
    if end_date:
        q = q.filter(Transaction.date <= end_date)
    txns = q.order_by(Transaction.date.desc()).all()
    return {
        "transactions": [
            {
                "id": t.id,
                "date": t.date.isoformat(),
                "type": t.type,
                "symbol": t.symbol,
                "quantity": t.quantity,
                "price": t.price,
                "amount": t.amount,
                "description": t.description,
            }
            for t in txns
        ]
    }

Append to backend/routers/accounts.py:

python
@router.get("/{account_id}/holdings")
def get_account_holdings(account_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    account = db.query(Account).get(account_id)
    if not account:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Account not found")
    total_value = sum(
        (h.last_price or 0) * h.quantity for h in account.holdings
    )
    result = []
    for h in sorted(account.holdings, key=lambda x: (x.last_price or 0) * x.quantity, reverse=True):
        mv = (h.last_price or 0) * h.quantity
        cb = (h.cost_basis or 0) * h.quantity
        gain = mv - cb if h.cost_basis is not None else None
        gain_pct = (gain / cb * 100) if (gain is not None and cb > 0) else None
        result.append({
            "id": h.id,
            "symbol": h.symbol,
            "quantity": h.quantity,
            "cost_basis_per_share": h.cost_basis,
            "last_price": h.last_price,
            "market_value": round(mv, 2),
            "gain_loss": round(gain, 2) if gain is not None else None,
            "gain_loss_pct": round(gain_pct, 2) if gain_pct is not None else None,
            "pct_of_account": round(mv / total_value * 100, 2) if total_value > 0 else 0,
            "last_updated": h.last_updated.isoformat() if h.last_updated else None,
        })
    return {"holdings": result}

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { useApi } from '../hooks/useApi'
import { api } from '../api/client'
import type { Account, TransactionList, HoldingsList, PerformanceData } from '../types'
import { LineChart, Line, XAxis, YAxis, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer } from 'recharts'

function fmt(n: number | null) {
  if (n == null) return '—'
  return n.toLocaleString('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD', maximumFractionDigits: 0 })
}

function fmtPct(n: number | null) {
  if (n == null) return '—'
  const color = n >= 0 ? 'var(--green)' : 'var(--red)'
  return <span style={{ color }}>{n >= 0 ? '+' : ''}{n.toFixed(2)}%</span>
}

type Tab = 'transactions' | 'holdings' | 'performance'

export default function AccountDetail() {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>()
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>('transactions')
  const [typeFilter, setTypeFilter] = useState('')
  const [symbolFilter, setSymbolFilter] = useState('')

  const { data: account } = useApi<Account>(() => api.get(`/accounts/${id}`), [id])

  const txnQs = `?type=${typeFilter}&symbol=${symbolFilter}`
  const { data: txnData } = useApi<TransactionList>(
    () => api.get(`/accounts/${id}/transactions${txnQs}`),
    [id, typeFilter, symbolFilter]
  )
  const { data: holdingsData } = useApi<HoldingsList>(
    () => api.get(`/accounts/${id}/holdings`),
    [id]
  )
  const { data: perfData } = useApi<PerformanceData>(
    () => api.get(`/accounts/${id}/performance`),
    [id]
  )

  if (!account) return <div className="empty"><div className="empty-sub">Loading…</div></div>

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, marginBottom: 24 }}>
        <button className="btn-ghost" onClick={() => navigate('/accounts')} style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
          ← Accounts
        </button>
        <h1 className="page-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{account.name}</h1>
        <span className="badge">{account.type}</span>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 2, marginBottom: 20, borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)' }}>
        {(['transactions', 'holdings', 'performance'] as Tab[]).map(t => (
          <button
            key={t}
            onClick={() => setTab(t)}
            style={{
              background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer',
              padding: '8px 16px', fontSize: 13, fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
              color: tab === t ? 'var(--text)' : 'var(--text-3)',
              borderBottom: tab === t ? '2px solid var(--text)' : '2px solid transparent',
              marginBottom: -1, textTransform: 'capitalize',
            }}
          >{t}</button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Transactions Tab */}
      {tab === 'transactions' && (
        <div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, marginBottom: 16 }}>
            <select
              value={typeFilter}
              onChange={e => setTypeFilter(e.target.value)}
              style={{ background: 'var(--card)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 6, padding: '6px 10px', color: 'var(--text)', fontSize: 13 }}
            >
              <option value="">All types</option>
              {['buy', 'sell', 'deposit', 'withdrawal', 'dividend', 'transfer'].map(t => (
                <option key={t} value={t}>{t}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
            <input
              placeholder="Symbol…"
              value={symbolFilter}
              onChange={e => setSymbolFilter(e.target.value)}
              style={{ background: 'var(--card)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 6, padding: '6px 10px', color: 'var(--text)', fontSize: 13, width: 120 }}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="card" style={{ padding: 0, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
            <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', fontSize: 13 }}>
              <thead>
                <tr style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)' }}>
                  {['Date', 'Type', 'Symbol', 'Qty', 'Price', 'Amount', 'Description'].map(h => (
                    <th key={h} style={{ padding: '10px 14px', textAlign: 'left', color: 'var(--text-3)', fontWeight: 400 }}>{h}</th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {(txnData?.transactions ?? []).map(t => (
                  <tr key={t.id} style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)' }}>
                    <td style={{ padding: '9px 14px', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>{t.date}</td>
                    <td style={{ padding: '9px 14px' }}><span className="badge">{t.type}</span></td>
                    <td style={{ padding: '9px 14px', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>{t.symbol ?? '—'}</td>
                    <td style={{ padding: '9px 14px', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>{t.quantity ?? '—'}</td>
                    <td style={{ padding: '9px 14px', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>{t.price != null ? fmt(t.price) : '—'}</td>
                    <td style={{ padding: '9px 14px', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>{t.amount != null ? fmt(t.amount) : '—'}</td>
                    <td style={{ padding: '9px 14px', color: 'var(--text-3)' }}>{t.description ?? ''}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
                {!txnData?.transactions?.length && (
                  <tr><td colSpan={7} style={{ padding: '24px 14px', textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--text-3)' }}>No transactions</td></tr>
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Holdings Tab */}
      {tab === 'holdings' && (
        <div className="card" style={{ padding: 0, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
          <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', fontSize: 13 }}>
            <thead>
              <tr style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)' }}>
                {['Symbol', 'Qty', 'Price', 'Value', 'Gain/Loss', 'G/L %', '% of Acct'].map(h => (
                  <th key={h} style={{ padding: '10px 14px', textAlign: 'left', color: 'var(--text-3)', fontWeight: 400 }}>{h}</th>
                ))}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {(holdingsData?.holdings ?? []).map(h => (
                <tr key={h.id} style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-subtle)' }}>
                  <td style={{ padding: '9px 14px', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)', fontWeight: 600 }}>{h.symbol}</td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '9px 14px', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>{h.quantity}</td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '9px 14px', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>{fmt(h.last_price)}</td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '9px 14px', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)' }}>{fmt(h.market_value)}</td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '9px 14px', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)', color: (h.gain_loss ?? 0) >= 0 ? 'var(--green)' : 'var(--red)' }}>
                    {h.gain_loss != null ? `${h.gain_loss >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${fmt(h.gain_loss)}` : '—'}
                  </td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '9px 14px' }}>{fmtPct(h.gain_loss_pct)}</td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '9px 14px', fontFamily: 'var(--font-mono)', color: 'var(--text-3)' }}>{h.pct_of_account.toFixed(1)}%</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
              {!holdingsData?.holdings?.length && (
                <tr><td colSpan={7} style={{ padding: '24px 14px', textAlign: 'center', color: 'var(--text-3)' }}>No holdings</td></tr>
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Performance Tab */}
      {tab === 'performance' && (
        <div className="card">
          <div className="section-label mb-16">Balance over time</div>
          {perfData && perfData.snapshots.length > 0 ? (
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={320}>
              <LineChart data={perfData.snapshots} margin={{ top: 4, right: 4, left: -4, bottom: 0 }}>
                <XAxis dataKey="date" tick={{ fill: '#5c5444', fontSize: 11 }} axisLine={false} tickLine={false} />
                <YAxis tick={{ fill: '#5c5444', fontSize: 11 }} axisLine={false} tickLine={false}
                  tickFormatter={v => v >= 1000 ? `$${(v/1000).toFixed(0)}k` : `$${v}`} />
                <Tooltip formatter={(v: number) => fmt(v)} labelStyle={{ color: '#5c5444' }}
                  contentStyle={{ background: '#1c1a14', border: '1px solid #26231b', borderRadius: 8 }} />
                <Line type="monotone" dataKey="balance" stroke="#c9a96e" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} />
              </LineChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          ) : (
            <div className="empty"><div className="empty-sub">No balance history yet</div></div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

First, add a GET /api/accounts/{id} endpoint to backend/routers/accounts.py (before the /{account_id}/transactions endpoint):

@router.get("/{account_id}")
def get_account(account_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    account = db.query(Account).get(account_id)
    if not account:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Account not found")
    snap = (
        db.query(BalanceSnapshot)
        .filter(BalanceSnapshot.account_id == account_id)
        .order_by(BalanceSnapshot.date.desc())
        .first()
    )
    return {
        "id": account.id,
        "name": account.name,
        "type": account.type,
        "institution_id": account.institution_id,
        "institution_name": account.institution.name if account.institution else None,
        "currency": account.currency,
        "created_at": account.created_at.isoformat() if account.created_at else None,
        "balance": snap.balance if snap else 0.0,
        "last_updated": snap.date.isoformat() if snap else None,
    }

Add a stalenessColor helper and update the account row to include the staleness dot and export link button. Insert before the component:

function stalenessColor(lastUpdated: string | null): string {
  if (!lastUpdated) return 'var(--red)'
  const days = (Date.now() - new Date(lastUpdated).getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)
  if (days < 3) return 'var(--green)'
  if (days < 7) return '#c9a96e'
  return 'var(--red)'
}
